Pfizer’s $2.3 billion bet on Trillium Therapeutics doesn’t look like it will ever pay out, with the Big Pharma abandoning the second and final clinical-stage candidate from that acquisition.
Olympus inked a collaboration deal for the global distribution of robot-assisted technologies produced by South Korea’s EndoRobotics with a focus on endoscopic procedures.
The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

With Gilead's $7.8 billion buyout of Arcellx complete, the California pharma is consolidating some of the workforce at the acquired company.
Johnson & Johnson MedTech is touting positive results from the first clinical study of its Ottava soft-tissue surgical robot, showing the system can safely perform gastric bypass surgery.
Novo Nordisk’s CEO has insisted that plans to launch the GLP-1/amylin combo treatment CagriSema remain on track, despite the pharma ending work on a single-chamber delivery device.

GSK has found another potential way to treat cardiometabolic disease with a modality close to the pharma’s heart—oligonucleotides.

A new bipartisan bill could end the import of primates for U.S. research, targeting the roughly 20,000 monkeys brought into the country each year for laboratories or their suppliers.
